body: U+0023# 10.47 phone checks on the Galaxy Note 10+ (Android 12), 2026-09-28 11:57-12:15U+000AU+000ABuild: debug APK from aa5bf95 as dev.satanshumishra.field_notes.probe (label field_notes_probe, FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON), clean install over the old probe. The owner's app dev.satanshumishra.field_notes was never touched. Evidence: ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/results/android/phone-2026-09-28.U+000AU+000AU+002D Reminder without Settings: PASS. First launch booked 7 alarms at 20:30 (Sep 28 - Oct 4) with Settings never opened. force-stop cleared them (0 pending); reminder_time set to 12:02 in the pulled settings table and pushed back via run-as; relaunch booked 7 at 12:02; at 12:02:00 the alarm fired and NotificationRecord id=1001 channel daily_reminder posted as heads-up: "Field Notes / You haven't written today's field note yet." Saving an entry later cancelled today's and kept the next six (10.6 live).U+000AU+002D Month picker in the accessibility dump: PASS. uiautomator dump holds Jan-Dec, Previous year, Next year, Back to this week, Dismiss month picker; tool/a11y/android_dump_rules.dart --density 420 reports nothing for picker, calendar, today.U+000AU+002D Tab ring with a hardware keyboard: PASS in the shell (gear, mood card, bottom bar), Settings (12:02 PM time button, switches) and the composer (format bar, More formats). Method matters: `adb shell input keyevent TAB` moves focus but never shows a ring, because Flutter 3.44's _HighlightModeManager ignores key messages from deviceId -1 (virtual keyboard) for highlight mode (flutter/flutter#180746). A real keyboard was simulated with Android's `hid` shell command (/dev/uhid, shell is in the uhid group): a boot-keyboard descriptor registered as EXTERNAL KEYBOARD|ALPHAKEY, reports fed from a file; with it the ring shows. Enter activated New entry, Write a note and More formats; Escape closed More formats before the composer (10.29).U+000AU+002D 10.23: PASS. Open More formats menu (Strikethrough, Highlight, Inline code, each 420x126 px = 48 dp) and the long-press-revealed pill (Edit note, Delete entry, 126x126 px) produce no findings from the dump checker. "today · 1 log" singular (10.33).U+000AU+002D NEW (keyboard, phone layout): Tab order on Settings follows screen geometry, so controls under the translucent bottom bar share its row; each Tab cycle visits the five bar buttons plus one or two Settings controls, and the list advances only one control per cycle. Today's cycle is fine (gear, mood card, five bar buttons). Severity: Hurts (only for hardware-keyboard users on a phone).U+000AU+002D NEW (cosmetic): the focus ring on settings switches is the same dark colour as their resting outline and only slightly thicker, so a focused switch is hard to tell apart. Android also draws its default lime focus highlight around the whole FlutterView after the first key press.U+000AU+002D Cleanup: temporary HID keyboard removed (dumpsys input shows none), test app's daily reminder switched off (0 pending alarms), phone left on the home screen.U+000AU+002D Host watch for the Mac sandbox session ended: software-events=432, all from Logi Options+ (the owner's mouse software), none from the agent's tools.
